rationale.faithfulness: The regime-III collective talk memory survives scheduler removal (V5 +0.052; #51 +0.042 [0.014, 0.070]), is uncorrelated with c_x, sits within rooms (Pi ~ 15) and is reproduced by H67's independently fitted read-out gain (ratio 0.96): coupling, not a slow drive.
